title: 5 suspected robbery group members killed in Bacoor police shootout; 2 ex-cops among fatalities
summary: Five suspected members of a robbery-hold-up group were killed in a shootout with police following a high-speed chase in Bacoor City, Cavite, on Tuesday afternoon, November 3.
